mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO marketing_account_occupancy (account_id, marketing_task_id, occupied_at, created_at, updated_at, tenant_id) SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id, mt.id, #{occupiedAt}, #{occupiedAt}, #{occupiedAt}, mt.tenant_id FROM marketing_task mt JOIN marketing_task_target t ON t.marketing_task_id = mt.id WHERE mt.id = #{taskId} AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL AND mt.status IN (1, 2, 5) AND t.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY t.account_id ASC
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id AS accountId, o.marketing_task_id AS marketingTaskId, mt.task_name AS taskName, mt.task_end_at AS taskEndAt, o.occupied_at AS occupiedAt FROM marketing_task_target target JOIN marketing_account_occupancy o ON o.account_id = target.account_id JOIN marketing_task mt ON mt.id = o.marketing_task_id AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL AND mt.status IN (1, 2, 5) WHERE target.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY o.account_id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM marketing_account_occupancy WHERE marketing_task_id IN ( SELECT mt.id FROM marketing_task mt WHERE mt.marketing_template_id IN #{id} )
DELETE FROM marketing_account_occupancy WHERE marketing_task_id NOT IN ( SELECT mt.id FROM marketing_task mt WHERE mt.deleted_at IS NULL AND mt.status IN (1, 2, 5) )
